game.rules:
**Global Rules**:

- **PC only**: One FPS cap may be used in a mission (switching outside of missions is permitted). Switching the FPS cap mid-mission, through in-game or external means, is disallowed. Verifiers reserve the right to reject submissions of poor viewing quality, and submissions which don't show a framerate counter (Options -> Video -> Show FPS).
- Beacons are banned.
- Platinum usage is banned.
- [Invigoration](https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Helminth#Invigoration) buffs of any kind are banned.
- Intentional out-of-bounds or wall-glitching techniques are forbidden. This applies to companions [(Master's Summons)](https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Master's_Summons).
- Performing interactions while in an ability state intended to disable interactions (such as Razorwing) is forbidden.
- All runs for any category require single-segment video proof, unless explicitly stated.
- Alternative mission variants (nightmare, fissures, et al.) do not satisfy the original mission's node requirements.
- Items, Warframe build swaps, and revives are allowed, unless explicitly stated.
- The HUD should be on.

**Co-op Specific**:

- Co-op runs must begin and end with the same players.
- You may not run missions in parallel for Co-op runs.
- Any intentional disconnects/crashes will invalidate your submission for Co-op runs.

[More information](/wf/guide/0zwnh)

For any inquiries please message one of the staff members here on speedrun.com or [Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/7wtcKvv).

levels.rules:
**Post-7/20/2019:** ALL **Top 5** submissions MUST have builds shown in the same video (no cuts allowed).

**Objective:** Complete the Parkour course located in the clan dojo. Completion is dictated as successfully navigating around the inner out-of-bounds walls without touching it.

** NOTE: ** Macros are banned for Dojo Parkour. Simple macros may be condoned by DE, but given the deterministic nature of this stage it should be mentioned here explicitly that macro'd Dojo Parkour runs will not be accepted.

* All [Global Rules](/wf/guide/0zwnh#ch2Global_Rules) must be adhered to.
* Only [In Game Time](/wf/guide/oe489#ch1_In-Game_Time) is available to utilize.

* Arcane enhancement procs are not allowed to be active when starting a new run through the course.
* Any submissions that shows signs of the Warframe receiving fire damage from the lasers will be treated as a co-op run.
* **In-game name must be shown at the end of the run by opening the Esc menu or by opening your chat and sending a message (default key: T).**

levels.rules:
**Objective:** Successfully capture the Eidolon Teralyst, Eidolon Gantulyst, and Eidolon Hydrolyst using Eidolon Lures as fast as possible.

**Completion Requirement:** You must show proof the loot dropped from the Eidolon Hydrolyst Lure explosion for the Tridolon run to be considered valid. Failure to provide proof of this requirement will result in 15 seconds being added to your submission.

* All [Global Rules](/wf/guide/0zwnh#ch2Global_Rules) must be adhered to.
* All [Timing Standards](/wf/guide/oe489) are available to utilize.
* When timing for RTA, time starts once the loading icon _disappears_ upon load and ends when the shards/shard icons appears after the lure explodes. 
* In the case that the mission is beginning from the orbiter, time starts when the loading icon in the centre of the diamond begins to fade out when loading. Refer to [this link](https://imgur.com/a/V4Y8Jws). In co-op it is HIGHLY advised to avoid orbiter loading (explanation in link) otherwise your run may have unavoidable time loss.
* When submitting in-game time for co-ops, only host's point of view will be considered. Host has to either record the submission or submit a corresponding screenshot of their Mission Success with a client video.
* [Damage Blessings](https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/True_Master%27s_Font) may be used. If solo please mark the run accordingly.

* Moving Eidolons around in unintended means is disallowed.

games.name: Warframe
games.rules:
**Global Rules**:

- **PC only**: One FPS cap may be used in a mission (switching outside of missions is permitted). Switching the FPS cap mid-mission, through in-game or external means, is disallowed. Verifiers reserve the right to reject submissions of poor viewing quality, and submissions which don't show a framerate counter (Options -> Video -> Show FPS).
- Beacons are banned.
- Platinum usage is banned.
- [Invigoration](https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Helminth#Invigoration) buffs of any kind are banned.
- Intentional out-of-bounds or wall-glitching techniques are forbidden. This applies to companions [(Master's Summons)](https://warframe.fandom.com/wiki/Master's_Summons).
- Performing interactions while in an ability state intended to disable interactions (such as Razorwing) is forbidden.
- All runs for any category require single-segment video proof, unless explicitly stated.
- Alternative mission variants (nightmare, fissures, et al.) do not satisfy the original mission's node requirements.
- Items, Warframe build swaps, and revives are allowed, unless explicitly stated.
- The HUD should be on.

**Co-op Specific**:

- Co-op runs must begin and end with the same players.
- You may not run missions in parallel for Co-op runs.
- Any intentional disconnects/crashes will invalidate your submission for Co-op runs.

[More information](/wf/guide/0zwnh)

For any inquiries please message one of the staff members here on speedrun.com or [Discord](https://discordapp.com/invite/7wtcKvv).
